$comment: The complete set of personalizable inputs. Everything else is system law. Copy to your project root as brand.json, edit, then run: python scripts/build_tokens.py brand.json --out-dir ./src/styles
name: Untitled Product

$options.primary: any chromatic hex; greyscale is rejected

fontPreset.grotesk: Geist / Geist / Geist Mono — default, precise and neutral
fontPreset.editorial: Instrument Serif / Inter / IBM Plex Mono — serif display
fontPreset.technical: IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Mono — engineered

$options.fonts: optional per-slot override of the preset. Slots: display, text, mono. A serif in the text slot is rejected; put serif faces in display.
